title: Section 1
context: A woman is phoning a restaurant to book a room for her mother's birthday party.

audio.t: Section 1. You will hear a woman phoning a restaurant to organise a birthday party.
Good morning, Harbourview Restaurant, Daniel speaking. How can I help you?
Hello. I'd like to book a table for a birthday party, please. It's for my mother's seventieth.
How lovely. Let me take down a few details. Could I have your surname, please?
Yes, it's Lindqvist. That's L-I-N-D-Q-V-I-S-T.
Sorry, was that Q-V or K-V in the middle?
Q, as in queen, and then V.
Got it, thank you. And what's the best contact number?
My mobile is best. It's oh seven nine one one, two six four, five oh eight.
That's 07911, 264 508. Thank you. Now, how many people will be coming?
Sixteen, I think. Actually, my aunt has just told me her two sons are coming as well, so it'll be eighteen altogether.
Eighteen, that's fine. Our private room seats up to twenty, so you'll have plenty of space.
Wonderful. I was hoping for Saturday the twelfth of June.
I'm afraid we have a wedding booked on that day. Would the Sunday, the thirteenth, be possible?
Yes, that's fine. It's probably easier for the relatives who are travelling, anyway.
Good. And what time would you like to start?
Seven o'clock, if that's possible.
Well, the private room has to be empty by ten thirty, and you'll want time for the speeches and the cake. Could you manage half past six?
Yes, that's a good idea. Half past six, then.
Perfect. The room we'll give you is called the Garden Room, and it looks out onto the terrace.
That sounds lovely. Now, I should mention dietary needs. One of the guests is allergic to shellfish. No, sorry, that's my brother, and he isn't coming after all.
So nobody has a shellfish allergy?
That's right. It's my cousin Hannah who has an allergy, and hers is to peanuts.
Thank you, I'll let the kitchen know. They'll make sure none of the dishes for her contain nuts.
Also, we're bringing our own cake. Is that all right?
Of course, and there's no charge for that. We can keep it in the fridge until you need it. What flavour is it, so that the staff know?
It's lemon. I know chocolate is more popular, but it's my mother's favourite.
Lovely. Now, about the menu. We have a two-course set menu at twenty-four pounds, or a three-course one at twenty-eight pounds per person.
I think we'll go for three courses, then. Twenty-eight pounds each is fine.
Great. We ask for a deposit of five pounds per person, which is taken off the final bill.
So five pounds times eighteen. That's ninety pounds, isn't it?
That's right, ninety pounds. You can pay it over the phone with a card.
I'll do that now, if I may. I have my card here.
Certainly. I'll just transfer you to our payment line. Please hold for a moment.

blocks.instructions: Complete the booking form below. Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

questions.explain: Người gọi đánh vần "L-I-N-D-Q-V-I-S-T"; nhân viên hỏi lại Q-V hay K-V và được xác nhận là Q, V.
"oh seven nine one one, two six four, five oh eight" — phần còn thiếu sau 07911 là 264 508.
Ban đầu chị nói "Sixteen, I think" rồi sửa: hai người con của dì cũng đến nên "eighteen altogether".
Chị muốn thứ Bảy ngày 12 nhưng nhà hàng có tiệc cưới; nhân viên đề nghị "the Sunday, the thirteenth" và chị đồng ý.
Chị đề nghị bảy giờ, nhưng phòng phải trống trước 10 rưỡi nên nhân viên gợi ý "half past six" và chị chấp nhận (6.30).
Nhân viên nói: "The room we'll give you is called the Garden Room".
Chị nhắc hải sản (shellfish) nhưng đó là em trai chị và anh không đến; người dị ứng là Hannah: "hers is to peanuts".
"It's lemon. I know chocolate is more popular, but it's my mother's favourite." Chocolate chỉ được nhắc để so sánh.
Thực đơn hai món giá 24 bảng, ba món 28 bảng; chị chọn ba món: "Twenty-eight pounds each is fine".
Đặt cọc 5 bảng mỗi người, 18 người: "That's right, ninety pounds". Không dùng số 16 người ban đầu (sẽ ra 80).
